navNote.body: Gross exposure can exceed 100% of SBG equity value because it precedes debt and the holdco discount. June 30 issuer NAV: ¥83.11T adjusted holdings less ¥10.81T SBG adjusted net debt = ¥72.30T. Those are dated balances, not live NAV. SVF2 already includes OpenAI. Management co-investment has preferred-capital and fund-wide hurdles, so neither the 13% headline nor a flat 17.25% reduction establishes shareholder-attributable ownership. July $10B is funded; October $10B is planned. The $40B bridge is a facility limit. The August $10B SVF2 loan agreement has an SBG guarantee, cash-collateral account and OpenAI-value triggers; its net funding use is not independently reconciled here. See /sftby for the dated NAV bridge and allocation sensitivities.
